summary: Public projects created on 22 October 2026: 8 repos and 3 datasets.
intro: Agent plugins for Claude Code covered microphone tuning, music video generation, planning documents, spending limits, Ubuntu hotkeys and vendor bug reporting. Election work included a 2026 Knesset model and reference datasets on the outgoing Knesset, candidate lists and polls. A voice-clone conversation and its alignment data rounded out the repositories.

projects.name: ASR Mic Tuner
projects.description: ASR Mic Tuner: tune your microphone for speech recognition on KDE Plasma — true analog gain, level, clipping, noise and voice analysis, tray

projects.name: Claude AVP Music Video Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: turn audio (e.g. Suno songs) into branded music videos with audio-visualizer-python (avp) — templates, brand kit, karaoke lyrics, AV1 encode

projects.name: Claude Planning Docs Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: keep a repo's decision log and plans lean — record numbered decisions, compact old decisions and plans in place.

projects.name: Claude Spend Approval Limit
projects.description: CLAUDE.md snippet: a spending approval limit for AI agents — autonomous below it, estimate-and-ask above it

projects.name: Claude Ubuntu Hotkey Builder
projects.description: Claude plugin: find free keys and build working shortcuts, macros and text-injection hotkeys on Ubuntu (X11/Wayland, KDE/GNOME)

projects.name: Me And My Voice Clone
projects.description: A ten-minute conversation between me and a TTS clone of my own voice (Meorav v2.0, Qwen3-TTS fine-tune): original video, audio, per-line clips, alignment data and splice pipeline

projects.name: Vendor Liaison
projects.description: Report bugs, request features and disclose security issues to software vendors: structured channel data per vendor, routing rules, and your own preferred channels and contacts. Agent skills.

projects.name: Israel Election 2026 Candidate Lists
projects.description: This dataset contains every candidate list for the election to the 26th Knesset, held on 27 October 2026.

projects.name: Israel Election 2026 Polls
projects.description: This dataset contains every published seat-projection poll for the 27 October 2026 Knesset election, from 23 December 2022 to 22 October 2026.

projects.name: Israel Knesset 25 Members
projects.description: This dataset covers the outgoing 25th Knesset, elected on 1 November 2022, at the end of its term ahead of the 27 October 2026 election.
